contents.title: Sticky Note Production Prompt
contents.description: Vertical 9:16 video, 15 seconds. Mimi stands in a quiet hallway with a yellow sticky note on her sleeve. Wide shot establishes the hallway; medium shot shows her noticing the note; close-up reveals the handwritten arrow. She follows it to a cupboard, pauses, and leaves the mystery unresolved. Keep character identity and lighting consistent. No captions or dialogue.
